International Graduate Students
International Graduate Students
As an international graduate student at Rowan University, you’ll join ambitious classmates from all over the globe to do work that matters.
Ready to Apply?
Start the Process
Submit your International Graduate application and pay $65 (USD) application fee.
Invite your recommenders, and let them know they can submit their recommendation electronically. However, you may also upload a PDF copy of the letter to your application portal.
Review specific requirements when selecting your program of choice.
Proficiency in both written and spoken English is absolutely necessary for successful study at Rowan University. Prospective international students must submit proof of English language proficiency during the application process. For accepted English language proficiency tests, minimum reqiured scores and exemptions, view Rowan's English Language Policy.
Review Rowan University’s International Admissions Policies
Apply
Requirements
College Transcript and Copy of Original Degree – If you have completed more than one degree, all academic credentials should be submitted. Additionally, if your document is not translated to English a certified English translation is required. A Foreign Credential Evaluation Report is optional.
Professional resume/CV
At least two (2) references for M.S. applicants and three (3) for Ph.D. applicants - Can be professional or academic references. Must be submitted on official letterhead and unique to the student.
Statement of professional objectives – Provide reasons for pursuing the program applied. Describe how you will use this program to reach your career goes, and educational goals beyond the master’s level if applicable. Students should also identify personal qualities that they want the committee to see in them, such as leadership, concerns for others, talent, etc.
Share your standardized English language test score with Rowan University – Rowan’s TOEFL code is 2515, Rowan’s Pearson Test of English (PTE) code is M7V. For Duolingo, please add Rowan University to your “My Colleges” list. Official IELTS score reports can be verified with the TRF# in the bottom right corner. International students must submit standardized test scores unless they are exempt (View Language Policy).
You can upload the required documents to your application portal once you submit your application. Additional items may be required depending on the program applied.
Apply
Check Application Status
Your application portal will always have the most up-to-date status of your application. To check the status of your application, log into your application portal. This is also where your decision letter will be posted.
Enrollment Deposit: $250 (USD) non-refundable*
*There are no waivers available.
